channel.title: The War Zone - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The War Zone (twz.com)

item.title: Ukraine’s Saab 340 Airborne Early Warning Radar Plane Spotted Operating Over The Country
item.description: After keeping a very low profile, a video has emerged apparently showing a Saab 340 airborne early warning and control aircraft over Ukraine. After keeping a very low profile, a video has emerged apparently showing a Saab 340 airborne early warning and control aircraft over Ukraine.

item.title: F-22 Raptor "2.0" Spotted Undergoing Flight Testing
item.description: We've gotten our best look at yet at new stealthy underwing tanks and sensor pods for the F-22, and the USAF's new AGM-181 nuclear cruise missile.

item.title: Iran Wants To Make Deal To End War, Trump Claims (Updated)
item.description: The U.S. president says Tehran reached out to try to negotiate a deal, something that Iran has vehemently denied. The U.S. president says Tehran reached out to try to negotiate a deal, something that Iran has vehemently denied.

item.title: New Army 6.8mm Carbine Recycles XM8 Designation From Failed “Starship Troopers” Rifle Program
item.description: For a time in the early 2000s, the Army looked poised to adopt a very different XM8 family of small arms.

item.title: Retired Patriot Battalion Commander On The Challenges Of Defeating Iran's Barrages
item.description: David Shank, former commandant of the Army's Air Defense Artillery School, offers a frank assessment of how air defenses are performing against Iran.

item.title: Is The U.S. Dropping Mines To Stop Iranian Missile Launchers?
item.description: Scattering mines around remote missile facilities and launch points would make sense in order to further degrade Iranian launches.

item.title: Private F-5 Adversary Jets Taking The Fight To Navy Fighter Pilots
item.description: TWZ Special Access: We visited TacAir to learn about their heavily upgraded F-5AT fighters and how they replicate enemy aircraft to keep U.S. fighter aircrews sharp.

item.title: Hardened Underground Facilities Now Being Sought For Al Udeid Air Base
item.description: Iranian attacks highlight the glaring need for hardened infrastructure and shelters to protect troops and military assets.

item.title: Bunker Talk: Let’s Talk About All The Things We Did And Didn’t Cover This Week
U.S. Is Burning Through Tomahawk Cruise Missile Stockpile At An Alarming Rate: Report
item.description: The four-week conflict with Iran has so far consumed more than a whopping 850 Tomahawk missiles, officials have stated. The four-week conflict with Iran has so far consumed more than 850 Tomahawk missiles, officials have stated.

item.title: Images Show E-3 Sentry Totally Destroyed From Iranian Strike (Updated)
item.description: A loss of an E-3 is a major blow for the dwindling fleet of increasingly rickety airframes and points to other capability and defensive gaps.

item.title: Israeli F-16s Appear To Be Carrying Cluster Munitions
item.description: The cluster munitions likely have a very particular purpose aimed at neutering Iran's ability to launch long-range ballistic missiles.

item.title: A-10 Warthogs Are Doing Bizarrely Long Strafing Runs In Iraq
item.description: A-10s making nine-second-long gun runs is absolutely not normal.

item.title: Ukraine Using Private Air Defense Teams To Protect Industry Against Russian Drones
item.description: By mobilizing the private sector, Ukraine hopes to reduce the air defense burden on its troops while increasing coverage.

item.title: Dozens Of A-10 Warthogs Appear Poised To Join Epic Fury
item.description: The deployment of additional Warthogs comes amid increasing signs a ground operation on Iranian soil could come soon. The attack jets would provide additional firepower for a range of operations overland and in the littoral domain.
